Vesi Yoga.Formation: Any planet other than the Moon occupies the 2nd house from the Sun.
Vesi Yoga.Effects: The native is likely to be happy, hardworking, balanced, and respected.

Voshi Yoga.Formation: Any planet other than the Moon occupies the 12th house from the Sun.
Voshi Yoga.Effects: The native is likely to be generous, famous, learned, and financially comfortable.

Ubhayachari Yoga.Formation: Planets other than the Moon occupy both the 2nd and 12th houses from the Sun.
Ubhayachari Yoga.Effects: The native is likely to be strong, wealthy, healthy, and享有 a good reputation.

Sunapha Yoga.Formation: Any planet other than the Sun occupies the 2nd house from the Moon.
Sunapha Yoga.Effects: The native is likely to be intelligent, wealthy, and self-made.

Anapha Yoga.Formation: Any planet other than the Sun occupies the 12th house from the Moon.
Anapha Yoga.Effects: The native is likely to be healthy, famous, and inclined towards spiritual pursuits.

Durudhara Yoga.Formation: Planets other than the Sun occupy both the 2nd and 12th houses from the Moon.
Durudhara Yoga.Effects: The native is likely to be wealthy, charitable, and enjoy various comforts of life.

Kemadruma Yoga.Formation: No planets occupy the 2nd or 12th house from the Moon (excluding Sun, Rahu, Ketu).
Kemadruma Yoga.Effects: Can indicate struggles, financial instability, and loneliness if not cancelled out by other planetary placements.

Ruchaka Yoga.Formation: Mars is in its own sign or exaltation in a Kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th house).
Ruchaka Yoga.Effects: The native is likely to be brave, strong, wealthy, and a natural leader.

Bhadra Yoga.Formation: Mercury is in its own sign or exaltation in a Kendra.
Bhadra Yoga.Effects: The native is likely to be intelligent, communicative, wealthy, and deeply educated.

Hamsa Yoga.Formation: Jupiter is in its own sign or exaltation in a Kendra.
Hamsa Yoga.Effects: The native is likely to be spiritual, moral, pure-hearted, and respected by scholars.

Malavya Yoga.Formation: Venus is in its own sign or exaltation in a Kendra.
Malavya Yoga.Effects: The native is likely to be wealthy, beautiful, artistic, and enjoy luxuries and comforts.

Sasa Yoga.Formation: Saturn is in its own sign or exaltation in a Kendra.
Sasa Yoga.Effects: The native is likely to be hardworking, disciplined, authoritative, and a leader of the masses.

Gajakesari Yoga.Formation: Jupiter is in a Kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th) from the Moon.
Gajakesari Yoga.Effects: The native is likely to be intelligent, prosperous, virtuous, and respected.

Budhaditya Yoga.Formation: Sun and Mercury are conjunct in the same house.
Budhaditya Yoga.Effects: The native is likely to be intelligent, educated, and possess leadership qualities.

Lakshmi Yoga.Formation: The lord of the 9th house is in its own sign, exaltation, or a Kendra/Trikona, and the lord of the Lagna is strong.
Lakshmi Yoga.Effects: The native is likely to be very wealthy, attractive, and enjoy a luxurious life.

Saraswati Yoga.Formation: Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury are in Kendra or Trikona houses, or the 2nd house.
Saraswati Yoga.Effects: The native is likely to be highly learned, intelligent, artistic, and spiritual.

Chandra-Mangala Yoga.Formation: Moon and Mars are conjunct in the same house.
Chandra-Mangala Yoga.Effects: The native is likely to be wealthy, hardworking, and possess strong drive and ambition.

Neecha Bhanga Raja Yoga.Formation: A debilitated planet has its cancellation of debilitation (e.g., the lord of its exaltation sign is in a Kendra from the Lagna or Moon).
Neecha Bhanga Raja Yoga.Effects: The native may experience early struggles but eventually attains great power, wealth, and status.

Mangal Dosha.Formation: Mars is placed in the 1st, 4th, 7th, 8th, or 12th house from the Lagna or Moon.
Mangal Dosha.Effects: Can cause delays, disharmony, or obstacles in marriage and relationships.
Mangal Dosha.Remedies: Marrying another Manglik, performing Mangal Shanti puja, or chanting Hanuman Chalisa.

Kaal Sarp Dosha.Formation: All seven planets (Sun to Saturn) are placed between Rahu and Ketu in the birth chart.
Kaal Sarp Dosha.Effects: Can lead to sudden setbacks, financial instability, health issues, and delayed success.
Kaal Sarp Dosha.Remedies: Performing Kaal Sarp Shanti puja, worshipping Lord Shiva, and chanting the Maha Mrityunjaya Mantra.

Pitra Dosha.Formation: Sun is conjunct with Rahu, or the 9th lord is afflicted, often occurring when ancestors are not at peace.
Pitra Dosha.Effects: Can cause delays in marriage and childbirth, financial struggles, and obstacles in career progression.
Pitra Dosha.Remedies: Performing Shraddha ceremonies, offering food to crows, and donating to the needy in the name of ancestors.

Grahan Dosha.Formation: Sun or Moon is conjunct with Rahu or Ketu in the birth chart.
Grahan Dosha.Effects: Can cause mental stress, emotional instability, obstacles in education, and a feeling of being stuck in life.
Grahan Dosha.Remedies: Chanting the Gayatri Mantra, performing Grahan Shanti puja, and worshiping Lord Shiva and Goddess Durga.

Shrapit Dosha.Formation: Rahu and Saturn are conjunct in the same house.
Shrapit Dosha.Effects: Can create intense struggles, delays, and obstacles in various aspects of life due to past life karmic curses.
Shrapit Dosha.Remedies: Worshiping Lord Shiva, performing remedies for both Saturn and Rahu, and chanting the Durga Saptashati.

Kemadruma Dosha.Formation: No planets are present on either side of the Moon (no Sunapha or Anapha Yoga).
Kemadruma Dosha.Effects: Can cause emotional turmoil, isolation, financial fluctuations, and a sense of lacking support.
Kemadruma Dosha.Remedies: Worshiping Lord Shiva or Goddess Durga, wearing a pearl, and donating food/clothes.
